name: com.motiftrace/motif
title: Motif
description: Ask which channel brought the customers who paid. Revenue-first web analytics, read-only.

tools.name: ai_crawlers
tools.description: Daily AI crawler requests (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others, by self-reported User-Agent) seen by Motif's tracker and collector for one website. UTC days; default the last 28. Not a count of people or prompts.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

period.description: named window in UTC days instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

from.description: inclusive UTC start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 28 days

to.description: inclusive UTC end YYYY-MM-DD; default today (UTC)

tools.name: analytics_snapshot
tools.description: Analytics snapshot for one website: requested window, series, prior period, and the channel recommendation. from/to default to the last 60 days in time_zone (UTC if omitted).

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

period.description: named window instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

from.description: inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 60 days

granularity.description: day, week, or month; default day

tools.name: answer_checks
tools.description: Answer checks for one website: whether search-backed assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity) name or cite the site for its buyer questions, this week and the 8 before. An input, not a score. locked=true means the plan does not run checks.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

tools.name: impact_receipts
tools.description: Logged changes for one website (notes, releases from the deploy hook, Stripe price changes, Google click drops), newest first, the newest of them with a receipt (a long list leaves the oldest without one): revenue per currency, signups and visitors over the same number of days before vs after, the top mover, and a confidence label. status is waiting (under a day old), collecting (the after window is still open) or ready. Read-only.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

days.description: changes logged in the last N days, 1-366; default 90

tools.name: insights
tools.description: Weekly briefs for one website, newest first: title, body, the one action, and the evidence it cites. On the free plan only the newest brief has a body; older ones are locked=true titles.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

tools.name: journey_detail
tools.description: Full observed history of one pseudonymous journey (visits, signups, payments) in time order, so you can say how a customer found the site. Take journey_id from the journeys tool. Paginate with cursor.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

journey_id.description: journey_id from the journeys tool (64 lowercase hex characters)

tools.name: journeys
tools.description: Paginated observed journeys for one website. Filter by first-touch source and medium, lifecycle, sort, page, and limit.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

period.description: named window instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

from.description: inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 60 days

granularity.description: day, week, or month; default day

sort.description: newest, oldest, spent, or stage; default newest

tools.name: list_websites
tools.description: List websites on the authenticated Motif account.

tools.name: money_alerts
tools.description: Money alerts for one website: the alert rules (metric, condition, threshold, last reading against its expected band, open or not), the alerts that fired lately with the revenue at stake, and the channels they go to (kind and name only). Breakage alerts are in tracking_status.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

tools.name: money_leaks
tools.description: Revenue leaks for one website ranked by money at risk over the last 28 finalized Search Console days: weak snippets and positions against the CTR curve, keyword cannibalisation, checkouts started but not paid, and 404s getting search clicks. Each leak is lost visits x revenue per visit, with its basis (estimate, or upper_bound when it assumes every lost visit would have paid), confidence and one fix. Amounts are minor units of currency (cents for usd, whole yen for jpy).

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

currency.description: lowercase ISO 4217 code; default the website's main currency

tools.name: revenue_moves
tools.description: Why revenue moved for one website: the window against the same-length prior window, split into new and renewal revenue, the channels, landing pages, search queries and referrer hosts (any site, not only AI) that moved it (the top 5 per group; search_query is estimated from Search Console), and which sources over-index among new payers. Same from/to/time_zone/currency as analytics_snapshot. Quote summary and the movers; do not recompute them.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

period.description: named window instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

from.description: inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 60 days

tools.name: search_console_evidence
tools.description: Search Console evidence for one website: action, gates, and landing-page rows. Same from/to/time_zone/currency as analytics_snapshot.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

period.description: named window instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

from.description: inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 60 days

granularity.description: day, week, or month; default day

tools.name: tracking_status
tools.description: Is Motif still seeing this website? Last tracker event, last identified visitor, backend signup feed health, and the breakage alerts Motif's hourly check has open (tracker silent, signups silent or unmatched, visits dropped, Stripe or Search Console disconnected). An alert opens only once that check has recorded it, so judge the tracker by live and last_event_at too; empty alerts alone does not prove nothing is broken.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

tools.name: website_readiness
tools.description: Setup readiness for one website: a 0-100 score and SEO, AI, and measurement checks, each with one fix. Not a visibility score. Last 28 UTC days.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website
